plan_area_inventory.title: Agent/QA automation chooses Docker vs SSH vs other remote when code or intent requires it
Natural-language start container xy resolves to configured target and runs
CI/DI/QA/dev/release automations use remote config; manual daily path stays optional
Documentation separates automation-only remote usage from manual operator workflows

topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Enable automation so dev/CI/QA agents can select Docker vs SSH vs other remote targets when the changed code requires it; explicit phrases like start container xy should resolve from canonical config and run without the operator pasting connection details. Remote profiles are for CI/DI/QA/dev/release automations only; manual daily work should not depend on these files.

Cursor agent runtime plus optional GitHub Actions or similar CI; Docker Engine and remote Linux over SSH; host OS may orchestrate; extends existing .cursor/remote.json and release-targets env-reference patterns plus future automation flags.
Markdown rules and commands; Python validators and tests; shell and Docker CLI where applicable; extend current its-magic remote and runbook contracts without a new application stack.

Scratchpad-gated automation profile; agent rules for when to propose or run remote or diagnostic jobs; optional command or workflow hook; document automation-only remote config versus unchanged manual operator path.
Operator surfaces are CLI and documentation: runbook sections, command help, deterministic error codes when execution target is unknown; no graphical UI.
Secrets stay in gitignored .env and named env references in JSON; automation must not print credentials; agents must not read .env per US-0085; handoffs record which remote profile ran.
Fail-closed when execution target is ambiguous; bounded autonomy: natural-language intents and path-based cues map to deterministic profiles; avoid silent wrong-environment test runs.

Single story US-0086: policy, documentation, and scratchpad keys first; optional CI matrix or path-filter hooks in the same story if sized; out of scope: replacing US-0064 schema or full cloud provisioning.
